_comment: Octail's own egg. Octail downloads the official Teeworlds 0.7.5 Linux release from GitHub, checks it against a SHA-256 recorded in the script (the project publishes none), unpacks the dedicated server and its data/ (not the game client), writes a storage.cfg that puts the server folder first (settings, uploaded maps and logs where the file manager shows them) and an autoexec.cfg once, which Teeworlds runs at every start and a reinstall keeps, edited with the file parser before every start (port, name, password, map, game type, public listing, slots, rcon password); runs on octail-yolks' Debian image and adds the Ctrl+C stop, the log-only console (Teeworlds reads no standard input), the UDP port start check, install sandbox defaults and resource hints. DDNet, the Teeworlds-based race mod, has its own egg (ddnet.json).
name: Teeworlds
author: eggs@octail.net
description: Teeworlds is a free, open-source 2D multiplayer shooter: cute round characters, grappling hooks and fast deathmatch, team deathmatch, capture the flag and last man standing rounds.
startup: [ -x ./teeworlds_srv ] || { echo "Teeworlds is not installed: reinstall the server."; exit 1; }; exec ./teeworlds_srv

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Teeworlds installation script (Octail): the official 0.7.5 Linux release from GitHub, checked against the SHA-256
# recorded here, with the dedicated server and its data/ unpacked (not the game client). Failures exit non-zero.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail

## Teeworlds 0.7.5, the current release (2020). GitHub and teeworlds.com publish no checksum for it, so Octail
## recorded the archive's SHA-256 (2026-10-23). A new release needs it updated here.
VERSION=0.7.5
FILE=teeworlds-0.7.5-linux_x86_64.tar.gz
SHA256=20ff9664cb6de612278e697cfac6a9426ec4065a4f0a3fefaa5185df03e58b4c

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl tar gzip ca-certificates > /dev/null

if [ "$(uname -m)" != x86_64 ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: this egg installs Teeworlds' Linux x86_64 server (this node is $(uname -m))."
    exit 1
fi

cd /mnt/server
DL=/mnt/server/.teeworlds-download.tar.gz
URL="https://github.com/teeworlds/teeworlds/releases/download/${VERSION}/${FILE}"
echo "Downloading ${URL}"
if ! curl -fSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 1800 --retry 3 -o "$DL" "$URL"; then
    rm -f "$DL"
    echo "Installation failed: the download from GitHub failed."
    exit 1
fi
if ! echo "${SHA256}  ${DL}" | sha256sum -c --quiet -; then
    rm -f "$DL"
    echo "Installation failed: the download doesn't match Teeworlds ${VERSION}'s checksum."
    exit 1
fi

## the release's own files (the server and data/); autoexec.cfg, your maps and other files stay
rm -rf data
tar -xzf "$DL" --strip-components=1 --exclude='*/teeworlds' --exclude='*/storage.cfg' -C /mnt/server
rm -f "$DL"
if [ ! -x /mnt/server/teeworlds_srv ] || [ ! -d /mnt/server/data/maps ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: teeworlds_srv is missing after unpacking ${FILE}."
    exit 1
fi

## the server folder itself first: settings, uploaded maps and logs are where the file manager shows them (the
## release's storage.cfg would put them in ~/.teeworlds first)
# shellcheck disable=SC2016
printf '%s\n' '# Octail: the server folder first (where settings, maps and logs go), then the release data/.' \
    'add_path $CURRENTDIR' 'add_path $DATADIR' > storage.cfg
mkdir -p maps

## your settings file, only when there is none: Teeworlds runs it at every start, and Octail sets the lines below
## before every start (Startup tab)
if [ ! -f autoexec.cfg ]; then
    cat > autoexec.cfg <<'EOF'
# Your Teeworlds server settings (run at every start). Octail sets the lines below before every start (Startup
# tab); add your own settings under them (sv_scorelimit, sv_timelimit, sv_maprotation, sv_motd, ...).
sv_port 8303
sv_name "My Teeworlds server"
password ""
sv_map "dm1"
sv_gametype "dm"
sv_register 1
sv_max_clients 12
sv_rcon_password ""
EOF
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed: Teeworlds ${VERSION}."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server browser (up to 64 characters, no double quotes or backslashes).

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it to join. Empty = no password. No double quotes or backslashes.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map loaded at start, without .map: dm1, dm2, dm3, dm6, dm7, dm8, dm9, ctf1 to ctf8, lms1, or a map you upload into maps/.

variables.name: Game Type
variables.description: dm (deathmatch), tdm (team deathmatch), ctf (capture the flag, use a ctf map), lms (last man standing) or lts (last team standing).

variables.name: Public Server List
variables.description: 1 registers the server with the Teeworlds master servers; 0 keeps it off the list (players join by address).

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Optional: the admin password for the in-game remote console (F2). Empty = Teeworlds makes a random one at every start and prints it in the console. 8-32 characters, no spaces, quotes, backslashes or semicolons. Hidden once saved.
